SAP S/4HANA (NW Gateway)
• Core Transactional ERP System of Record (Finance & Operations) · Mission-Critical Enterprise Ledger
• SAP NetWeaver Gateway (OData v2/v4, RFC, BAPI Services) · High-Availability Transaction Execution
• Direct Integration with Google Cloud ABAP SDK (/GOOG/ Package) & Enterprise Change Data Capture

Flow 1: User Request & Cognitive Dispatch
• End User initiates inquiry via Natural Language Chat or IDE.
• Intent parsing determines whether No-Code assistant or Pro-Code agent handles the request.

Flow 2: A2A Collaboration & Dynamic MCP Tools
• Pro-Code Agent negotiates with SAP Joule via Agent-to-Agent (A2A).
• Agentic Connectors call SAP MCP Gateway via Model Context Protocol to discover live ERP tools.

Flow 3: Zero-Copy Analytics & Cortex Grounding
• BigQuery and SAP Datasphere (BDC) share telemetry via Zero-Copy federation.
• Cortex Framework models enrich agent prompts with verified semantic operational context.

Flow 4: Action Execution & Core ERP Settlement
• Validated actions executed via REST/OData onto SAP S/4HANA and Line-of-Business SaaS.
• ABAP SDK and BigQuery Connector stream live confirmation events for continuous audit.
